svg.title: Broad Queue Throughput · Median of 7 Runs (Windows · MSVC 19.44 · Release · 32 logical CPUs)
svg.desc: Each line represents one queue implementation or calling mode, including the original and optimized Hakle paths. The horizontal axis shows balanced producer and consumer configurations from 1P/1C through 24P/24C. The vertical axis shows median throughput in millions of items per second on a logarithmic scale so single-item and bulk operations remain visible together.
svg.title: Broad Queue Throughput · Median of 7 Runs (Windows · MSVC 19.44 · Release · 32 logical CPUs)
